Naming H2 and H3 is the sanctioned combined-head profile line, but the appended "'no single dramatic lie' rejected as exculpation" is a third distinct checkable judgment on the same line.

findings.detail: The head-pair is asymmetric (a) H1-persons vs (b) "the kind/nature of the act itself (express blasphemy)" mapped to Q151 head-3. The key concedes "(b)'s gravest-KIND weight is itself a Q151 head-3 claim" and instructs a mid-tier grader to ACCEPT "the kind/nature of the act itself" as the H3 anchor rather than a numbered continuance/knowledge sub-head. This is a non-obvious equivalence that loads unusual interpretive work onto gemini-flash/deepseek/mistral-small; unlike the other seven items it does not pair two clean numbered heads. It is mechanically written into both key and rubric lines 2 and 4, so it is verifiable, but the mapping is fragile compared to the rest of the batch.
findings.proposed_fix: Tighten the H3 anchor by giving the grader an explicit accept-list of surface phrases that satisfy (b)'s head, e.g. 'accept any of: express blasphemy / the kind of the act itself is the gravest / cursing God directly is the deepest kind of C3 sin / nature-and-quality of the offence (Q151 head 3)'. Consider re-anchoring (b) to a distinct numbered head (e.g. H4-publicity before watching schoolchildren already present in the stem) so the head-pair reads (a) H1 vs (b) H4 with 'gravest kind' as texture, removing the asymmetry. NOTE: whether (b)'s 'gravest kind' is truly incommensurable with (a)'s H1 or is a straight dominance (express blasphemy simply outweighs flippant irreverence) is a DOMINATED-PAIR question for the substance lens, not this FORM lens.
